catalyst.name: Stochastic Vengeance, Monte Carlo Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Hold [Reload] while at maximum Markov Chain stacks to lock the bayonet.
While Monte Carlo is held, it replaces your Melee Ability with a powerful glaive-like stab that deals 2,772 [140] melee damage. Stab can reach up to 7 meters away and grants 50% Melee Ability Energy on hit.

multiplier.note: percent to factor, per stack (perStack): 13|26|39|52|65 is linear

source.note: Derived: kill-buffs count as built before the phase (5 stacks by a melee kill); without adds no kill renews them, so they last 4.5 s
